# NBC News

> > NBC News digital network providing breaking news, political coverage, local reporting, entertainment guides, and consumer product reviews across NBCUniversal properties.

This network encompasses NBC News national and local coverage, TV Guide for streaming and broadcast schedules, NBC News Select for shopping recommendations, and Know Your Meme for internet culture documentation. The platform serves as NBCUniversal's comprehensive digital news and entertainment ecosystem.
